items.title: Avaota F2 – Allwinner V861 RISC-V SBC targets AI cameras with PTZ and audio support
items.summary: Avaota F2 is the first SBC based on an Allwinner V861 dual-core 64-bit RISC-V SoC with 128MB on-chip DDR3 memory, support for 4K cameras, H.265 video codec, and a 1 TOPS AI accelerator. It’s an update to the earlier Avaota F1 camera board based on an Allwinner V821 SoC. The new open-source hardware F2 SBC offers several benefits, including support for both Full HD and 4K camera sensors, motor control for the PTZ (Pan-Tilt-Zoom) feature, and improved audio support through speaker (one) and microphone (two) connectors. However, the F1 also included WiFi, which the Avaota F2 lacks. items.title: Walnut Pi CM2 – A cheaper Raspberry Pi CM5 alternative based on Allwinner T527 octa-core SoC
items.summary: Walnut Pi CM2 is a low-cost Raspberry Pi CM5-compatible Compute Module powered by an Allwinner T527 octa-core Cortex-A55 processor paired with up to 4GB LPDDR4 RAM, 16GB eMMC flash, and an optional wireless module. It’s basically the company’s Walnut Pi 2B credit card-sized SBC in Pi Compute Module form factor, exposing I/Os via two 100-pin high-density connectors. Besides the price, benefits include a WiFi 6 and Bluetooth 5.0 module, a Gigabit Ethernet PHY on the module, and a built-in 2 TOPS NPU in the T527 SoC. Downsides are that the Allwinner T527 is not quite as powerful as the Broadcom BCM2712 (4x Cortex-A76 cores) found in the CM5, and as with other such “Raspberry Pi CM5-compatible” modules, it’s only partially electrically compatible. items.title: Nordic nRF54LC10A – A tiny Bluetooth LE and 802.15.4 SoC with sub-50 nA hibernation mode
items.summary: Nordic Semiconductor recently expanded its nRF54L Series with the nRF54LC10A, a new SoC with less memory and a smaller peripheral set compared to the higher-end nRF54L15, while supporting Bluetooth LE with Channel Sounding and IEEE 802.15.4 for Thread, Zigbee, and Matter. Built on a 22nm process, the SoC combines a 128 MHz Arm Cortex-M33 processor with a multiprotocol 2.4 GHz radio. It also features a sub-50 nA hibernation mode for devices shipped with (3V) batteries installed, reducing battery drain during storage and transportation. items.title: Linux Begins Seeing Workarounds For Fujitsu MONAKA CPU Bugs
items.summary: Last month Fujitsu formally announced their MONAKA CPU as a 144 core Arm-based server processor geared for AI infrastructure. This comes after two years of seeing various Monaka patches to the GCC compiler and other open-source components. Now that MONAKA is announced, we are seeing more patches surface for the Linux kernel with this week seeing several workarounds for MONAKA CPU bugs...
items.title_zh: Linux内核开始为富士通MONAKA CPU缺陷提供临时方案
items.summary_zh: 上月富士通正式发布面向AI基础设施的144核Arm服务器处理器MONAKA。此前两年已有Monaka相关补丁陆续进入GCC等开源组件，本周Linux内核再出现多个针对MONAKA CPU缺陷的临时解决方案。
items.why_it_matters_zh: MONAKA正式进入Linux内核适配阶段，标志Arm服务器生态正加速扩展至AI基础设施领域。

items.title: Arm Working On "TLBID" For Linux To Increase Performance On High Core Count CPUs
items.summary: Arm sent out an initial set of patches this week working on support in the Linux kernel for TLBI Domains. This "TLBID" feature is an upcoming Arm architecture capability designed to increase performance on high core count systems...
items.title_zh: Arm开发TLBI域功能以提升Linux在高核数CPU上的性能
items.summary_zh: Arm本周向Linux内核提交TLBI Domains（TLBID）支持的初始补丁。该特性属于即将推出的Arm架构功能，旨在通过改进TLB失效广播机制，提升高核心数系统的整体性能。
items.why_it_matters_zh: TLBID可显著缓解高核数Arm系统的TLB瓶颈，对未来数据中心与AI芯片性能至关重要。

items.title: Apex Compute Developing Open-Source Mesa Vulkan Driver For Their Hardware
items.summary: Apex Compute is the company started in California in 2024 that aims to produce high-efficiency AI accelerators for real-time edge AI inferencing. So far they have an FPGA prototype for licensing and deployment and carries the bold claim of being "20x faster than the NVIDIA Jetson" and at under 10W and one fifth the cost. Making Apex Compute much more interesting to us now is that they are developing an open-source, Mesa-based Vulkan driver for their hardware...
items.title_zh: Apex Compute 为其硬件开发开源 Mesa Vulkan 驱动
items.summary_zh: 总部位于加州的 Apex Compute 成立于 2024 年，专注于实时边缘 AI 推理的高能效 AI 加速器，目前拥有 FPGA 原型可供授权与部署，并声称性能是 NVIDIA Jetson 的 20 倍，功耗低于 10W，成本仅为其五分之一。该公司现正为其硬件开发基于 Mesa 的开源 Vulkan 驱动。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 边缘 AI 加速器搭配开源 Vulkan 驱动有助于推动硬件生态开放，便于开发者评估与集成。

items.title: Mesa Drops Its Poorly Maintained & Rarely Used Direct3D 10 User-Mode Driver
items.summary: Back in 2021 the Direct3D 10 User-Mode Driver "d3d10umd" was introduced as a new Gallium3D state tracker to work as a Windows WDDM UMD driver similar to Windows WARP while leveraging LLVMpipe for better performance. Now five years later the poorly maintained code is removed from the Mesa codebase...
items.title_zh: Mesa 移除维护不善且少用的 Direct3D 10 用户模式驱动
items.summary_zh: 2021 年作为新的 Gallium3D state tracker 引入的 Direct3D 10 用户模式驱动 d3d10umd，类似 Windows WARD，利用 LLVMpipe 提升性能。五年后，这段维护不善的代码已从 Mesa 代码库中移除。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 移除长期闲置且维护不善的代码可精简 Mesa 项目结构，集中资源投入活跃组件的维护。

items.title: Critical Link MitySOM-AM62x/A/P – TI Sitara AM62 SO-DIMM SoMs for edge AI and industrial automation
items.summary: Critical Link MitySOM-AM62x/A/P is a family of TI Sitara AM62-based industrial SO-DIMM SoMs designed for embedded Linux systems, industrial automation, HMI, and other embedded applications. The family includes the general-purpose MitySOM-AM62, AI-focused MitySOM-AM62A, and multimedia-oriented MitySOM-AM62P system-on-modules. The standard AM62 modules feature up to a quad-core Arm Cortex-A53 processor at 1.4 GHz, along with a 400 MHz Cortex-M4F MCU and dual programmable real-time units (PRUs). The AM62A adds a C7x DSP with Matrix Multiply Accelerator supporting up to 2 TOPS and an image signal processor (ISP), while the AM62P includes a 3D GPU rated above 50 GFLOPS and a four-lane MIPI DSI output. items.title_zh: Critical Link推出基于TI Sitara AM62的MitySOM-AM62x/A/P工业SO-DIMM系统模块
items.summary_zh: Critical Link推出基于TI Sitara AM62的MitySOM-AM62x/A/P工业SO-DIMM系统模块系列，面向嵌入式Linux、工业自动化及HMI应用。系列包括通用型AM62、集成C7x DSP与2 TOPS算力的AI版AM62A，以及搭载3D GPU与MIPI DSI的多媒体版AM62P，可选四核Arm Cortex-A53处理器。
items.why_it_matters_zh: MitySOM系列覆盖通用、AI与多媒体三大场景，提供模块化选择，便于工业边缘设备快速集成。

items.title: CyboPal ONE – An AI-powered, 6-DOF robotic terminal with 27-inch 4K display that adjusts to your posture (Crowdfunding)
items.summary: CyboPal ONE is a 6-axis desktop robotic terminal designed to move a 27-inch 4K display using voice and gesture control, spatial sensing, and automatic display positioning based on the user’s position. It includes a camera, a binocular 3D sensor, and a motion sensor (IMU), and supports joint force sensing, obstacle avoidance, collision detection, and power-loss soft landing. The 6-DOF arm has a 747 mm reach and supports face tracking, manual adjustment, and saved positions. A built-in Pauli agent also provides voice control for screen positioning, application control, text input, and workflow tasks across Windows, macOS, and Linux. items.title_zh: CyboPal ONE：搭载RK3588的6自由度AI桌面机器人终端
items.summary_zh: CyboPal ONE是搭载Rockchip RK3588的6自由度桌面机器人终端，可自动调节27英寸4K显示器以适配用户姿态，支持语音、手势及空间感知控制。集成双目3D传感器、IMU和Pauli AI助手，臂展747 mm，适用于Windows、macOS和Linux。
items.why_it_matters_zh: RK3588驱动的人机交互终端融合机器人与AI助理，展示了多自由度机械臂在桌面场景的实用价值。

items.title: Brainchip AKD1500 M.2 and PCIe Edge AI cards, BrainBoard 1500 SPI module now available for $99 and up
items.summary: Back in November 2025, we wrote about the Brainchip AKD1500 PCIe/SPI Edge AI co-processor designed for low-power systems and delivering up to 800 GOPS at just 300 mW. In recent months, the company has launched several hardware platforms based on the ADK1500. At the end of July, Brainchip introduced the AKD1500 M.2 B+M Key development card for $129, shortly followed by the $99 BrainBoard 1500 module in August, and a few days ago, the company started selling the AKD1500 PCIe development card for $149.
